Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was derived from tissue and cell lysates. Although the samples were fractionated by SDS-PAGE and specific gel bands (75-150 kDa) were excised to isolate the full-length protein by molecular weight, this is a size-selection step during sample preparation rather than a subcellular fractionation (e.g., nuclear or cytosolic) or an affinity-based purification. Therefore, the input material remains whole cell/tissue lysate.
